_readme: The one place the site's addresses live. Generators, entity.py, check-site.py and scripts/build.py all read this file. Source files always carry PRODUCTION addresses; staging is produced by scripts/build.py --env staging and never written back into source. See _site/README.md.

analytics._note: GA4 measurement ID, e.g. G-DH86WNW6FE (the live WordPress site's). Null = no tag. Setting it also needs the privacy page to name Google Analytics, or the build warns.

verification._note: Content values of the google-site-verification and msvalidate.01 meta tags. Null = no tag. DNS verification needs neither.
